ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 40:60 ratio of high-intensity white pixels to low-intensity black pixels across the visible ventral surface area.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration pattern observed along the entire trailing edge; right lobe exhibits higher pixel-amplitude peaks (approximately 5-8 pixels) compared to the left lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Trailing edges exhibit a moderately concave mathematical curve sweeping upward toward the distal tips.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent vertical dark linear mark (potential scar or pigmentation break) bisecting the white distal patch on the right lobe, extending from the trailing edge inward.
other_distinctive_markers: Isolated high-contrast white focal point located within the lower margin of the central black zone, left of the median notch.
